findings.text: Early confidential guest preparation ensures that firmware provided metadata and the associated processor identification area are reachable through identity mappings when the relevant guest mode is active, with subsequent validation of the memory encryption bit against the supplied top level table.
Low level verification entry receives a page table base, performs an encryption bit correctness probe when encryption state indicates a protected guest, and returns the same base for continued boot.
When encryption masks or guest status indicate no protected execution, the verification entry leaves processor state untouched and proceeds without additional probing.
A mismatch during the encryption bit probe is treated as fatal; the routine discards stack context and enters a non returning halt cycle to block further progress.
Command line locator combines the low portion from the main boot header with the extended high portion to form a single full address.
Small mapping helpers adjust attributes of an individual address, one requesting encrypted treatment and another requesting removal of present status, reporting failure through a status code.
Early fault reporting emits a diagnostic message with fault classification, faulting address and instruction offset relative to boot entry, with unconditional boot abort.
Early page fault entry normalizes the faulting address to its enclosing large page boundary and establishes an identity mapping for that range after sanity screening.

Faults on already present pages, faults from user mode, faults signalling reserved bit violations, and faults targeting the special hypervisor communication page are all considered unexpected and lead to fatal handling rather than mapping.

Communication page fault detection has two forms: a default form that never matches, and a guest aware form that matches when the fault address falls within the same page as the dedicated communication buffer.
Early nonmaskable interrupt entry records an occurrence in a global counter and otherwise ignores the event.
Boot interrupt gates use trap type with present set and kernel code segment, with the handler address distributed across three offset portions of the descriptor at the indexed slot.
The compressed stage copy routine guarantees safe behaviour under overlap by detecting a destructive forward overlap case and delegating to move semantics with a diagnostic notice.

Multiple copy interfaces exist for early environments: a builtin based macro for the initial boot stage, an assembly word oriented routine for real mode, and portable copy and move routines for the compressed stage with distinct width optimized back ends.
Low level copying transfers the bulk of the length in word sized units appropriate to the build width, handling any remainder with byte sized transfers.

Exception handling progresses through three phases: an initial table with only a conditional hypervisor communication handler, a fuller table with fault and nonmaskable handlers plus conditional communication handling, and a final disabled state with a null table after shutdown duties.

Initial communication handling depends on build configuration, while later communication handling depends on observed guest status, with the vector explicitly cleared when the required guest mode is absent.

Shutdown handling for the hypervisor communication page is either a no operation default or, for guests using that page, a transition that abandons page based communication, restores encrypted mapping with cache effects addressed, and then makes the page not present.
Missing processor features or failures to change mapping attributes during communication page shutdown abort boot, and after successful shutdown any later use of that page is intended to fault.
The compressed stage randomization seed is derived by repeatedly mixing build identity text and the full boot parameter block through a rotate and exclusive or combiner starting from zero.

Placement avoidance uses a fixed array with dedicated entries for the decompression overlap range, initial ram disk, command line, boot parameters, and a small bounded run of firmware memmap reservations.
The maximum number of firmware memmap avoidance entries tracked during compressed stage randomization is four.
The maximum number of placement candidate areas retained during compressed stage randomization is one hundred.
Each placement candidate records a base address and a count of aligned image positions fitting inside the region, accumulated in a global array with an index and a running total of positions.

Interval overlap is defined as neither range lying entirely before the other, and candidate validation reports the earliest overlapping avoidance entry considering the static table, the firmware setup chain, and any indirect target referenced by that chain.

Avoidance initialization covers the unsafe decompression span, the initial ram disk extent from split low and high fields, the command line extent including terminator, the boot parameter block extent, firmware option reservations, and the count of immovable regions.

Firmware option handling operates on a private copy of the command line, stops at the conventional separator, and dispatches memory reservation, large page reservation and global limit options while ignoring an unrelated legacy token.

Firmware reservation parsing accepts size with explicit address markers as reservations, treats usable region markers and bare sizes as limits rather than reservations, and rejects malformed or uninteresting forms without recording.
When more firmware reservations are supplied than the bounded avoidance run can hold, excess input is ignored and a flag records that randomization input was truncated.

Large page reservation tracking activates only for the one gigabyte size, warns on repeated size declarations or unparsable counts, and accumulates the requested number of such pages for later exclusion.

Memory region evaluation enforces minimum and global limit bounds, aligns the start, emits non overlapping portions capable of holding the image, clips past the earliest overlap and repeats until the region is consumed or candidate storage is full, optionally intersecting with immovable extents first.

Random placement selection yields zero when no candidates exist, otherwise selects uniformly across the total number of aligned positions and maps the selection to the corresponding candidate area and stride offset.

Regions containing aligned one gigabyte blocks exclude up to the configured number of such blocks from placement consideration, retaining only leading and trailing remainders large enough for the image, and bypass exclusion entirely when the feature is disabled or no count remains.

Early string helpers provide conventional search, compare with unsigned byte ordering, bounded length measurement, substring location returning the first match or null, unbounded length measurement, and leading whitespace skipping.

Early boot and randomization state including descriptor tables, avoidance entries, candidate areas and global counters is accessed without synchronization, reflecting a single threaded execution context before concurrency is established.

Certain compile time markers denote inclusion guards and compressed randomization context, diagnostic hex output is an alias for the underlying hex printer, and the default immovable region count is zero when the relevant enumeration is unavailable.
